transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical services, my name is Rachel. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Rachel, my name is Stefan Varga. I bought a new iPhone 15 and I am attempting to transfer my existing S-Net mobile eSIM from my old iPhone 12, but every time I scan the QR code or initiate the quick transfer, the screen spins for ten minutes and times out with error code SIM-ERR-503!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon. If I understand correctly, your mobile eSIM transfer between your old iPhone 12 and your new iPhone 15 is timing out after ten minutes with error code SIM-ERR-503. Let me inspect your mobile subscriber profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My mobile number is 07700 900742, account reference SN-449102, registered at 45 Victoria Road, Swindon, SN1 3BD, security PIN 9021.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that brings up the mobile line.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why is the eSIM transfer timing out?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the GSMA eSIM subscription manager server?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding. The subscription manager server indicates that the cryptographic eSIM profile is still locked to the EID chip on your old iPhone 12.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How do we unlock the profile from the old phone?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The previous eSIM profile must be deleted from the old handset, and a brand new SM-DP+ activation code must be generated for the new EID.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I deleted the mobile plan from the old iPhone 12 settings just now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am generating a fresh eSIM profile for your new device.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How will I receive the new eSIM profile?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Rachel? Are you there? The line was silent for forty seconds!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was waiting for the GSMA carrier gateway to sign the security certificate.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will the QR code be emailed to me?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously carrier eSIM certificates require cryptographic signing before dispatch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, I understand security signing is necessary.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The new eSIM activation QR code has been emailed to your registered email address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me check my email... Yes, email received from S-Net with subject 'Your New S-Net eSIM Activation Code'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I run an emergency heating and plumbing callout service during the winter months, and all our customer breakdown calls are routed directly to this mobile phone number! While this eSIM is stuck, my business is losing hundreds of pounds every single hour and vulnerable elderly residents with broken boilers cannot reach me in freezing temperatures! I am in absolute distress and panic over this outage!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the acute distress, financial loss, and severe worry you are experiencing, especially with elderly residents facing broken boilers in freezing temperatures and relying on your emergency heating callouts. Getting your mobile phone back online immediately is an absolute priority, and I will stay on the line to walk you through scanning the QR code right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Rachel, let's scan the code now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: On your new iPhone 15, open Settings, tap Mobile Service, and tap 'Set Up Mobile Service' or 'Add eSIM'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapping 'Add eSIM'... Camera scanner opened... Scanning QR code from my computer screen...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The screen should display 'Activating eSIM' and connect to the S-Net carrier profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The screen says 'Activating...' with a spinning wheel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The new profile is attaching to your device's EID chip.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It has been spinning for two minutes now... Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Network provisioning across the cellular towers can take between thirty minutes and up to four hours to fully propagate.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So the phone won't receive incoming calls right away?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct, the cellular network requires the provisioning cycle to complete before signal bars appear.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you divert incoming calls to a temporary landline number while it provisions?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I can set up an immediate network call divert to any UK landline or mobile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please divert all calls to my workshop landline 01793 521890.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Rachel? Did the call drop? Why does your line keep going silent?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was entering the network diversion parameters into our switch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is the divert active?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, immediate network call diversion to 01793 521890 is fully active.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will protect my emergency boiler breakdown customers while the eSIM completes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once the eSIM displays signal bars, you can cancel the divert by dialing hash hash 21 hash.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hash hash 21 hash, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have waived the eSIM replacement charge on your account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, I appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we conclude, what was that mobile phone number again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you right at the start of our call, it is 07700 900742.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, mobile number confirmed on the ticket.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for setting up the divert so quickly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It has been my pleasure assisting. Stay warm.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Rachel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other mobile issue today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical services. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
